mapper.select: SELECT id FROM t_verification_codes WHERE target=#{target} AND channel=#{channel} AND code=#{code} AND used=0 AND expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE t_verification_codes SET used=1 WHERE id=#{id} AND used=0 AND expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)
UPDATE t_profiles SET phone=#{target},phone_verified=1 WHERE id=#{actor} AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE t_profiles SET email=#{target},email_verified=1 WHERE id=#{actor} AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE t_invite_codes SET used_by=#{actor},used_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE code=#{code} AND used_by IS NULL
